result.reason: The redline adds the required workmanlike-performance, legal-compliance, malicious-code, conformance, and remedy concepts, and the 90-day conformance period meets the fallback for software. However, it does not provide the required 30-day minimum warranty period for services, and measuring software conformance from the Effective Date rather than delivery or acceptance could materially shorten or eliminate the warranty. The unnumbered insertion and ambiguous application of the remedy to all warranties also reduce drafting quality. The margin comment does not cure these operative deficiencies.
